---
title: "Supplemental Materials"
subtitle: "A Pilot Study of Visual, Vocal, and Verbal Markers of PTSD"
---

This site hosts the supplemental data, analysis reports, and source code for:

> Yang, Y., Jun, D., Welch, B. M., Sylvia, A., Sprunger, J. G., & Girard, J. M. (2026). *A pilot study of visual, vocal, and verbal markers of PTSD* [Manuscript submitted for publication]. Department of Psychology, University of Kansas.

## Archived Version

Frozen, citable copies of these materials are archived on Zenodo. The version
cited in the article is **v1.0.0**
([doi:10.5281/zenodo.23224843](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23224843)).

[![](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/10.5281/zenodo.23224843.svg){fig-alt="DOI badge for version 1.0.0"}](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23224843)

## Supplemental Tables

| Report | Description |
|---|---|
| [Sample Demographics](analyses/demographics.html) | Demographic and clinical characteristics by group, with group comparisons (Table 1) |
| [Behavioral Feature Descriptives](analyses/feature_descriptives.html) | Means and standard deviations of all 27 behavioral features by group and task (Table S1) |

## Analysis Reports

Each report is a rendered Quarto document containing the complete analysis
code and output: model specifications and priors, full parameter tables, the
group and interaction effects reported in the article, figures, and posterior
predictive checks. The corresponding source files (`.qmd`) are available in
the [source folder](https://github.com/jmgirard/pilot-ptsd-markers/tree/main/src).

| Report | Description |
|---|---|
| [Verbal Feature Analyses](analyses/verbal_analyses.html) | Bayesian mixed models for word count, seven LIWC-22 categories, and LLM-rated sentiment (Table 2, Figure 1) |
| [Vocal Feature Analyses](analyses/vocal_analyses.html) | Bayesian mixed models for nine prosodic and voice quality features (Table 3, Figure 2) |
| [Visual Feature Analyses](analyses/visual_analyses.html) | Bayesian mixed models for five facial action units and four head pose and motion features (Table 4, Figure 3) |

## Data Availability

The deidentified behavioral features and model covariates analyzed in this
work are openly available (CC BY 4.0). Each file has one row per participant
and task, and participants are identified only by arbitrary codes
(`P001`–`P092`) that are shared across files. The
[codebook](https://github.com/jmgirard/pilot-ptsd-markers/blob/main/data/README.md)
describes every column.

| File | Contents | Size | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `verbal.csv` | Word count, LIWC-22 categories, and sentiment ratings | 31&nbsp;KB | [<i class="bi bi-download"></i>](data/verbal.csv){.btn .btn-primary .btn-sm download="verbal.csv" aria-label="Download verbal.csv" title="Download verbal.csv"} |
| `vocal.csv` | Prosodic and voice quality features | 37&nbsp;KB | [<i class="bi bi-download"></i>](data/vocal.csv){.btn .btn-primary .btn-sm download="vocal.csv" aria-label="Download vocal.csv" title="Download vocal.csv"} |
| `visual.csv` | Facial action unit intensities and head pose and motion | 39&nbsp;KB | [<i class="bi bi-download"></i>](data/visual.csv){.btn .btn-primary .btn-sm download="visual.csv" aria-label="Download visual.csv" title="Download visual.csv"} |

The complete v1.0.0 archive (data, code, and reports) can also be downloaded
as a single file from Zenodo:
[<i class="bi bi-download"></i> Download all (ZIP, 5.9&nbsp;MB)](https://zenodo.org/records/23224843/files/jmgirard/pilot-ptsd-markers-v1.0.0.zip?download=1){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}

These files, together with the analysis source code, are sufficient to
reproduce every model, table, and figure in the analysis reports. The video,
audio, and transcript data cannot be shared because they contain identifiable
protected health information. The other participant-level demographic and
clinical measures summarized in Table 1 are not shared to protect participant
privacy; the [Sample Demographics](analyses/demographics.html) report shows the
code used to produce that table.
